contest.measure_text: Glendora Unified School District Classroom Repair Extension Measure. To repair or replace deteriorating roofs, plumbing, HVAC, electrical systems; remove asbestos and lead pipes; upgrade classrooms, labs, facilities to support college/career readiness in math, science, engineering, technology and skilled trades; shall Glendora Unified School District's measure be adopted, authorizing $86,000,000 in bonds at legal rates (without increasing current tax rates), levying approximately $33 per $100,000 assessed value ($5,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with independent oversight/audits, and funds locally controlled? Supporters: Art Ludwick; Glendora Ed Foundation; Dr. Cliff Hamlow, Fmr Mayor, Glendora Teachers Assoc.; Mendell Thompson, City Council Opponents: Mel Bennett
contest.office: GLENDORA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT SPECIAL ELECTION - MEASURE G
